cc3739e9f1b35b2aa47a1058.title: The fortress beneath Oakhurst
paragraphs: The company descended through these passages while searching for the missing Hucreles. Below Oakhurst, it first encountered the history of Ashardalon.

a88998139fd818cc86fa12c9.title: Below the fortress, the roots
paragraphs: The lower caverns led towards Belak and the Gulthias Tree, where the mystery of the strange apples took root. What looked like a local harvest carried a danger that could spread far beyond Oakhurst.

5cbd2015b6d87ac4041d6ff1.title: The first way down
paragraphs: The broken ground above the Citadel led towards the missing adventurers. Giant rats, traps and hidden passages guarded the way down.

f54c5527eed5f5f7867ad9fc.title: A whistle in an old tomb
paragraphs: The Night Caller lay among the old tomb’s forgotten magic. The tomb predated the goblin and kobold struggles the company found in the Citadel.

445808b4e0960603c7db09f6.title: Small teeth, early troubles
paragraphs: Giant rats attacked in the Citadel’s lower darkness. Shrop encountered them along with a pit trap on the way in.

bfa409a7daff3dd4326ef1de.title: Calcryx in the buried fortress
paragraphs: Calcryx was a white dragon wyrmling caught in the Citadel’s rivalries. This is her campaign image.

9a0798780413a1a42cf103a1.title: Balsag and the rat hounds
paragraphs: Balsag hunted with his rat hounds inside the buried fortress. Their lair was among the dangers surrounding the search for the missing adventurers.

8927361bb871086a9443fc6a.title: The Twilight Grove
paragraphs: Broken masonry opened onto the Twilight Grove. Here Belak’s work and the Gulthias Tree explained the danger in the apples sold aboveground.

12e9dc1dc2a4df46dc8642e2.title: The Dragon Priest's rest
paragraphs: The Dragon Priest’s tomb preserved the fortress’s old devotion to draconic power. Ashardalon’s history would recur long after the company left the Citadel.

3fcb2c0a3cad25fb60b56635.title: The Stone Tooth
paragraphs: The map recovered from the Citadel led towards Durgeddin's lost stronghold beneath this landmark. Reaching the mountain meant exchanging Oakhurst's buried ruin for the orc-held approaches to Khundrukar.

8677666c925f5971613b1d14.title: The Glitterhame
paragraphs: Water and fungi filled the Glitterhame beneath Khundrukar. The company crossed its caverns on the way towards the lower halls and Black Lake.

6d2241a26174d593d115f644.title: A dragon beneath the mountain
paragraphs: The illustration places a dragon beneath a precarious crossing. Nightscale waited at the end of the company’s own descent, in Khundrukar’s Black Lake.

9ff996e2d35960e86e31c7c5.title: Durgeddin's mountain
paragraphs: The Stone Tooth stood above Durgeddin’s lost forge. Orcs held the approaches when the company arrived.

f39f70a71d4e8d617de19863.title: Thunder's crossing
paragraphs: Thunder crossed Khundrukar’s rope bridge first. The rest of the company followed him across the rift.

1bb8525d962811b5d8c7186c.title: Growth in the Glitterhame
paragraphs: Fungi grew through the caverns below the stronghold. The unfamiliar growth and light accompanied the company’s passage through the Glitterhame.

c8ac931f9c9a6920745e05ac.title: Other smiths at the forge
paragraphs: Duergar worked at Durgeddin’s old forge. The company fought and questioned them while exploring the ruined hold.

6e2b3c90f6129d43ffa4a579.title: The Foundry's remains
paragraphs: The Foundry preserved the remains of Durgeddin’s work and signs of later occupants. Terry searched the stronghold for dwarven history and its lost craft.

bfdfb58a4da1a9073563e1e0.title: Nightscale's water
paragraphs: Nightscale waited beside the Black Lake at the bottom of Khundrukar. Its waters surrounded the island holding the dragon’s hoard.

48e9b1d14c75b001dcd5da84.title: The road between towns
paragraphs: The road from the early dungeons led to Brindinford. Its fair, temple and manor would become familiar stops in the company’s travels.

edd50327d6e4addc9e636169.title: A little theatrical deduction
paragraphs: The comic detective accompanies Brindinford’s investigation. Its clues led from the street fair towards the forces controlling the Baron.

3650110dc9770508dec3d0b4.title: The detective takes a bow
paragraphs: The purple-coated detective strikes another pose. The campaign’s joke accompanies the conspiracy uncovered beneath Brindinford’s fair.

3ffe83f1c6e06a254c87ae78.title: A dwarf fit for the road
paragraphs: This armoured dwarf illustrates the Forge chapter. Terry’s endurance and steel carried him through the search beneath the Stone Tooth.

b4f39b14480f9d7228b07ca6.title: Durnan's face
paragraphs: Durnan appears among the early campaign portraits. His image accompanies the inns and stopping places along the company’s road towards Brindinford.

a011e94063d27953a2a4dff7.title: An apple and an invitation
paragraphs: The verse about the fruit of labour accompanies the Citadel’s strange apples. Their harvest concealed Belak’s plan to spread twig blights.

5d0bbe4f94b29c353f94486f.title: Shatterspike, remembered
paragraphs: Shrop recovered Shatterspike in the Sunless Citadel. He later sacrificed it to cleanse Pelor’s temple in Brindinford.

8f6b2cd5cbe5d9830a1b4709.title: The crowded country around a dungeon
paragraphs: Roads and buildings surround the first dungeon’s countryside. Aboveground, the people of Oakhurst awaited news of the missing adventurers.

63ab90e7a7ee65da7b598c20.title: Akrew's grin
paragraphs: Akrew belongs to the conspiracy behind Brindinford's public troubles and the Baron's compromised authority. His familiar goblin face made the Stolen Sons connection especially unwelcome to Shrop and his companions.

163739c0ca45d2643b34b0a2.title: A small scout in a large adventure
paragraphs: The weasel illustrates the small scouts that explored ahead of the party. In Nightfang, familiars could inspect passages before their companions entered.

3c44da05b81a4e8df69eaf40.title: A mark upon the Stone Tooth
paragraphs: The marked mountain map pointed towards Khundrukar. Orc defences and Durgeddin’s lost works lay beneath the Stone Tooth.

585da672fa60a5b83c22f62b.title: Following Khundrukar's passages
paragraphs: The plan shows the upper routes through Khundrukar. Doors, crossings and defended rooms separated the entrance from the forge.

5897a1365e376e6427121ebd.title: A fortress imagined in stone
paragraphs: The illustration depicts a dwarven fortress in stone. It accompanies the search for Durgeddin’s legacy in the fallen hold of Khundrukar.

b57a8fada4d6d0a86ce2d42b.title: A doorway with an old story
paragraphs: Roots cross the carved stone doorway in this illustration. The Citadel’s ancient rooms likewise gave way to the dangerous growth beneath them.

ebce53de9a481357f6762460.title: The sign of the sun
paragraphs: Pelor's emblem places this small animation beside the struggle for his temple in Brindinford. A familiar holy sign became something the company had to defend when the town's supposed guardians turned against its priests.

f5a95d76bf0742cf0d3d5320.title: Strength carried on a belt
paragraphs: A giant’s face marks the magical belt. It illustrates the strength-enhancing equipment the company carried into its later battles.

d8d95dc4ad1ef311654eb699.title: The town before the mountain
paragraphs: Blasingdell was the company’s stopping place before Khundrukar. They returned there to rest between descents beneath the Stone Tooth.

80ef816bd7d934a02cf2afa7.title: Brother Calbert
paragraphs: Brother Calbert’s portrait accompanies Brindinford’s threatened priesthood. The company’s defence of Pelor’s temple brought it into conflict with those outlawing the priests.

8c7e614eee9973807be02257.title: A face carved in warning
paragraphs: The staring stone face accompanies Brindinford’s hidden chambers. The investigation beyond the fair uncovered madness and manipulation within the town.

308464d8ea6b5790934c4075.title: A beguiling face
paragraphs: The succubus portrait illustrates the deceptions surrounding the Baron’s court. It accompanies the company’s investigation of those controlling Brindinford.

6a8c45944b91655aa95351b2.title: Khundrukar, spread before them
paragraphs: This plan connects the hold’s approaches, forge and waters below. The company descended through them to Nightscale’s lair.

93f689726e512db35fe7dd6a.title: Brindinford before its fall
paragraphs: The manor, temple and bell tower appear among Brindinford’s streets. The company would recognise those landmarks in the later sunken ruins.

5467ff9563a1b0342ab1847f.title: The Reality Wrinkle
paragraphs: The old shop hid a passage into Brindinford's stranger troubles. Long after that first investigation, its surviving doorway would offer Team Biscuit a route out of the buried city and towards Windglum.

9a67a0902eacb392555b03e8.title: Above the streets, the bell tower
paragraphs: The bell tower overlooked Brindinford’s streets. It survived as a landmark even after the town below was ruined.

9f054236bddc797cb5de5e39.title: The threads behind the fair
paragraphs: This diagram connects the threats behind Brindinford’s unrest. The party traced them through rescued victims and questioned suspects.

e0c0c0a962f81e98ce2107c1.title: The manor on Silver Hill
paragraphs: The manor housed the Baron whose authority had been turned against Brindinford. The company fought its way inside to reach the mind flayer controlling him.

b61e5b18cbd9e163d00e3d02.title: Pelor's temple in plan
paragraphs: These chambers formed Pelor’s temple, whose priests the conspiracy outlawed. The company fought to cleanse it and restore the sanctuary.

d4f5b5770141eef1dab49f9b.title: Ways through the market
paragraphs: Brindinford's alleys could carry a crowd, a rumour, or an attacker out of sight. The fair made the town lively, while its narrow passages helped conceal the forces trying to seize it.

1ddf1030949e0ece8514c13b.title: The long street
paragraphs: Shops and homes line the street where crowds gathered. Team Biscuit first visited Brindinford during the Halfling Faire, before the city’s later ruin.

9f39fc9526da4b41376f1494.title: The Halfling Faire
paragraphs: Music and crowds welcomed the company to the Halfling Faire. Rats, wererats and the town’s conspiracy soon interrupted the celebration.

8e78f5fe6300bc2686c2915e.title: A place to stop
paragraphs: This roadside building illustrates the inns along the journey. Such stopping places offered meals, shelter and conversations between expeditions.

54086cb0509dcaae649e989f.title: The tower's upper reaches
paragraphs: The plan stacks the bell tower’s floors above Brindinford. The party investigated the landmark while searching for the cause of the town’s unrest.

f0e900894556e11b671fc366.title: The Stony Gaze
paragraphs: The company stayed at the Stony Gaze during its Brindinford adventures. After freeing the Baron, it was given the inn’s finest rooms.

664dd6d9fd537757e4a21ebd.title: High Priest Forgrim
paragraphs: Forgrim's stern portrait stands beside the effort to defend Pelor's temple and its people. When the Baron's decrees outlawed the priests, the town's crisis reached directly into the refuge they offered.

257136cf04919ad9096ae2b7.title: Torea's concern
paragraphs: Torea's face recalls the aftermath of the rescue from Brindinford's cultists and the gathering at Pelor's temple. Gratitude and worry shared the room, because the rescued could not yet explain how the evil had reached them.

7183e17c55cf616e95660c82.title: Captain Aldrich
paragraphs: Captain Aldrich served in the guard during Brindinford’s crisis. He confirmed the party’s suspicions about the wererats.

d49929ea4483b42056308cfe.title: The adventurers at the table
paragraphs: The tabletop scene shows the companions gathered in Brindinford. Its hospitality and feasts accompanied their investigation of the town’s conspiracy.

5e8473aeb1661dcbbb05c73c.title: A town beneath a hostile sky
paragraphs: The illustration shows streets beneath a threatening sky. It accompanies the fear that allowed Brindinford’s conspirators to offer their own remedy.

681d92215b8fd08955a38fb3.title: Thanks at Pelor's temple
paragraphs: Forgrim, Marith, Aldrich, and Torea gather around the rescued Alain as gratitude turns towards the question of what comes next. The temple scene leads into the Baron's summons, where reassurance would give way to a much harsher announcement.

5e669e708f391c5f9caba297.title: The bells call the town
paragraphs: The tolling bells summoned Brindinford to a public gathering. The company’s earlier help had not stopped the conspiracy from using that summons.

2b2b536d4b94ce97bbd41eb7.title: A gathering at the fountain
paragraphs: Figures gather around Brindinford’s fountain in this tabletop scene. The town square hosted crowds before the fighting spread through its streets.

6c180e7ad3f055fc4a2c8e90.title: The Baron's proclamation
paragraphs: Euphemes closes the fair and the city gates, bans weapons, and turns Pelor's priests into outlaws. The filmed proclamation gives a voice to the point where Brindinford's own authority became part of its imprisonment.

a0aa1a120567e46403bc1aa1.title: A city under an unnatural sky
paragraphs: Lightning and a blade-bright omen hang over the cityscape. The illustration accompanies the supernatural threats gathering over Brindinford.

0d01d4de42b4abf89ddff040.title: Axiom's hidden will
paragraphs: The mind flayer Axiom controlled Baron Euphemes. The company had to defeat him to free the Baron and the town.

0a5c463dcf5977efb8d8b0ae.title: Akrew's last welcome
paragraphs: Akrew greets Shrop and the company with the claim that the orders are already signed and the city belongs to the Stolen Sons. His little surprise summons old enemies into a confrontation the heroes could no longer avoid.

4727e2e0c906d842fdeeb00c.title: Another face of the mind flayer
paragraphs: The portrait depicts the mind flayer behind Brindinford’s troubles. The company’s investigation ended in battle against the creature controlling its ruler.

2d306c4e3636685a20667553.title: The company in the firelight
paragraphs: Fire surrounds the familiar party in this group image. It accompanies the journeys that followed their first dungeon expeditions.

a293eff02d896a38c2ba911e.title: The elemental bargain
paragraphs: The forest guardian recalls Grim’s elemental bargain before Nightfang. He promised to slay Gulthias within a year in exchange for magic.

7f7d7d6be88116550d6ab86b.title: A feast with shadows around it
paragraphs: The table is laid for a feast in Brindinford. Hospitality surrounded the company even while the town’s conspiracy remained active.

a0ec971fbee5508a6d6592d1.title: Muscle at the wrong doorway
paragraphs: The scarred brute illustrates the violence behind the early conspiracies. His portrait accompanies the confrontation at the Baron’s manor.

e6040aa15774f15d17704419.title: Ossington within the stones
paragraphs: Houses and fields stood inside Ossington’s double circle of stones. The company arrived with provisions and found Dyson’s experiments behind the village’s welcome.

2a7f5ff60d6981055e4bd493.title: A cottage near the mystery
paragraphs: The cottages and cultivated ground show Ossington as its visitors first saw it. Dyson’s transformed companions lived among those familiar-looking buildings.

8af34633f00118f80995d1bd.title: Saithnar, remembered in stone
paragraphs: The ancient warrior’s image accompanies Saithnar’s barrow. Despite Dyson’s warnings, the company negotiated with him and learned about Dydd, Ashardalon and Gulthias.

9c130bff463d247dff018cb3.title: Ossington after dark
paragraphs: The village lies in shadow beyond its houses. The night view accompanies the company’s investigation of Ossington’s stones and barrows.

60bbe3ca7f1d5d2746e98dbc.title: Beneath Red Horse Hill
paragraphs: The chambers descend below Red Horse Hill. The tarn and its broken crystal connected Ossington’s troubles with Ashardalon’s missing heart.

8e1d56a81bcb147f018fa4d4.title: The Silence Keepers' stones
paragraphs: The circle marks the ancient Silence Keepers’ site. Ossington’s stones preserved duties and magic from before Dyson’s experiments.

a2c69679c986c5c4954004f2.title: Reaver's Spike
paragraphs: Reaver’s Spike rests in a bleak setting. The weapon illustrates the old warfare surrounding Saithnar and Ossington’s barrows.

afcb3899fe277728a22e2095.title: A landscape of uneasy paths
paragraphs: Broken paths, water and woodland surround the approaches to Ossington. Grim transformed Shrop into an eagle when the company needed to race back after its failed ambush.

2acc421133e950930af6c5af.title: The island in the tarn
paragraphs: The island and crossing sit within the tarn. Nearby, the company sought answers from the Horseman about Dyson and the villagers.

1995eec8c922a197415127f9.title: Fire over Ossington's chapter
paragraphs: A burning dragon fills this illustration. It accompanies the Ossington chapter’s ambush, exploding tower and escape, rather than depicting an additional dragon encounter.

21537f6fbd24bc81ba381512.title: The shape of Nightfang Spire
paragraphs: Nightfang’s circular tower stood above buried chambers. Its sealed walls concealed Gulthias’s dead cult.

6301ab2a9274149dea0d5169.title: The tower's first floor
paragraphs: The first-floor plan shows Nightfang’s interior chambers. Traps, undead and hidden doors guarded the routes onward.

f6e8bd9fd6ed2a319ac30675.title: Nightfang, level by level
paragraphs: The plan continues through Nightfang’s guarded rooms. Grim found secret doors there and survived a pit trap with a prepared spell.

203f2c6cac13bbea6ebe071f.title: Another ring of chambers
paragraphs: Curved walls repeat around another floor of Nightfang. Behind its doors waited further creatures serving Gulthias.

ee820553d705eb42eb7c63c0.title: The heat inside the tower
paragraphs: Fire and enclosed chambers formed part of Nightfang’s defences. The cult’s old rooms were being used to support Gulthias’s return.

8d84cada7d620030acb7fce2.title: Below the tower's crown
paragraphs: The upper chambers stood within Ashardalon’s former temple. Gulthias preserved its undead cult alongside his own power.

3f31a3634842eb857ea3c944.title: Nightfang's core
paragraphs: At the tower's heart, the circles and chambers drew the company's descent towards Gulthias. Defeating the vampire would expose another part of the long history surrounding Ashardalon's ruined heart.

260d380140411027b924f0d7.title: Thunder's other shape
paragraphs: The wererat image illustrates the curse Thunder disclosed after the Citadel expedition. His companions knew about it before the pursuit of Dydd’s blood began.

a26399a2aea1236d4090cf79.title: Four figures in the hall
paragraphs: The four companions stand together in a grand stone hall. Monsters wait at a distance in this campaign group image.

204116b0c05cac1cab27fa90.title: A closer plan of the first level
paragraphs: Numbered rooms fill the lower-tower plan. Grim’s search for secret ways and his fall into a pit trap took place among such passages.

516c032e843286e221226330.title: The mohrg
paragraphs: The mohrg served among Gulthias’s undead in Nightfang. Its skeletal form accompanies the former temple’s occupied halls.

b17de4f725a71b9da99d42c9.title: A guardian made of grave-stone
paragraphs: The tombstone golem guarded Nightfang’s funerary halls. The company encountered it during the descent towards Gulthias.

91d121340edafedc99e20c4e.title: Grim brings his own light
paragraphs: Grim holds fire and cold magic in this portrait. It accompanies his search for lore and the battles within Nightfang.

681aeae5d8ce040963eb9ded.title: The earth answers
paragraphs: The earth elemental recalls Grim’s bargain before Nightfang. The magic it granted came with his promise to slay Gulthias within a year.

b5937ff7aff37a71f3553962.title: A face among the wights
paragraphs: The wight served in Gulthias’s undead cult. Such guardians stood between the company and the vampire.

71367dc36becda40375be9f2.title: A warrior out of the older tale
paragraphs: The armoured warrior illustrates Ossington’s older history. Saithnar supplied answers about that past when the company spoke with him.

e33d8b3866f589b234156f09.title: The mooncalf above the Spire
paragraphs: Shrop leapt at the mooncalf while berserk. The creature’s campaign image accompanies that encounter at Nightfang.

a2da8036651b2296481da3b5.title: The room of Stitches
paragraphs: Tables, tools and scattered contents fill Stitches’s chamber. The room illustrates the flesh-working horrors within Gulthias’s domain.

45604e43dc012de4d9703496.title: Blood upon the wood
paragraphs: The blood-marked warrior illustrates Shrop’s cursed-axe chapter. His insistence on using the weapon accompanied the dangers inside Nightfang.

5578433578ca585f7ac06e4d.title: Pale Piercer
paragraphs: Pale Piercer was among the magical blades gathered during the campaign. Its pale edge accompanies the weapons carried beyond Nightfang’s dark halls.

9bce1504c06b7b9aa1e7c216.title: Stitches
paragraphs: The company overcame Stitches in Nightfang. Its assembled body was one of the tower’s flesh-made horrors.

88b5b9c29a3eb8a61979b95e.title: Rhunad in the tower
paragraphs: Rhunad served among Nightfang’s named foes. The winged figure opposed the company on its way towards Gulthias.

a72f9f08e06d4934a6ae0004.title: Too many eyes in the dark
paragraphs: The many-eyed horror illustrates the dangers behind Nightfang’s doors. The company scouted and searched those rooms before committing to the next passage.

70afa7793e848c2e7d05f7fe.title: Thiff the Smart
paragraphs: Thiff led girallons resisting Gulthias beneath Nightfang. His rebellion divided the creatures living in the catacombs.

3ea5df7b5dd87aeae1b4401d.title: The girallon alpha
paragraphs: Gulthias conditioned girallons into servitors. Thiff’s rebellion challenged that control in the catacombs beneath the Spire.

3da191f5932b1f078ae86d0c.title: The treasure bites back
paragraphs: The mimic takes the shape of a tempting chest. Khundrukar also held animated furniture ready to attack an intruder.

5fc05cf4807cb7b9162f187c.title: A fortress below the surface
paragraphs: Guarded passages connect the chambers of this underground stronghold. The plan accompanies the war between the peoples of Deep Horizon.

faee4a83293e6912840d45ff.title: The shrine above the magma
paragraphs: Vesperian’s shrine stood within the desmodu realm. Its chambers place the company’s discoveries within the enclave’s religious and civic life.

2ded77a5be2354b19bb575ab.title: Fire under Vesperian's shrine
paragraphs: Magma lay below Vesperian’s shrine. In Deep Horizon, the company had to cross and eventually divert the fire beneath the settlements.

0220b6c580d84d6d2e23517e.title: One of the desmodus
paragraphs: The desmodus had homes, records and enemies in the depths. The company reached their enclave while an assault threatened it.

81ba4717e6ecc67397034f3b.title: Light beneath the earth
paragraphs: Light fills the cavern around the desmodu enclave. The company explored this underground landscape during the war with the salamanders.

04264cc2a4c11cc708c882f4.title: A warbat of the deep
paragraphs: The armoured warbat flew above the deep battlefield. It appears among the creatures of the enclave conflict.

20bb9ec3438ed11a8fe8c416.title: A desmodu defender
paragraphs: The desmodu raises a weapon to defend its home. The company arrived while the enclave was under attack.

c248263e801ba8e95dfa248b.title: A weapon from an unfamiliar people
paragraphs: The curved weapon shows the craft of the deep communities. Their equipment differed from that carried in the surface towns.

4e03dbeaa0b6c72b2a16532f.title: A pause by the water
paragraphs: Water turns through a quiet part of the underground landscape. The scene offers a pause between the expedition’s guarded passages and battles.

70b576aaf3de932adbb7d801.title: The branches of an underground journey
paragraphs: Caverns, settlements and guarded approaches spread across this location diagram. The company followed their connections through the underground war.

f3eab28be8f657193e06da4c.title: A vrock in the deep
paragraphs: The vrock's wings and hooked face belong to the fiendish dangers surrounding the underground fighting. The company was learning that descending beneath the surface could also bring it closer to powers from much farther away.

8c9ea1a5204750b06a91c655.title: A settlement in the cavern
paragraphs: Buildings cluster inside the cavern. Communities lived along the underground routes the company was exploring.

dd23c6d51e7ce9cdb9cb73ba.title: The desmodus, armed and named
paragraphs: The fuller depiction shows the desmodus with their arms and equipment. Their enclave was the community the Brotherhood tried to save by diverting lava.

87b1e71336f3a50ff4d23e86.title: Helkitrin
paragraphs: Helkitrin offered records while pleading for his life. They linked the salamanders’ slave trade to the Stolen Sons and missing people from the surface towns.

41e053f0f6b0f4711c02bd26.title: The salamanders' upper stronghold
paragraphs: Lava lights the salamanders’ upper citadel. Its defended chambers supported their assault on the desmodu enclave.

a65886559ca6bb0475cdb657.title: Below the salamander citadel
paragraphs: The salamanders’ lower passages extend around the molten ground. They continued the defences beneath the upper citadel.

0066bbb628017a2be9620bc8.title: The great tree and the lost elves
paragraphs: A great tree stands within the elven settlement. It recalls the elven histories the company followed from Ossington into the deep expedition.

18337dfe4336b24d7e86e279.title: The citadel's lower reaches
paragraphs: The plan enlarges the salamander citadel’s lower chambers. Those defences formed part of the force threatening the enclave.

2c556d3b353ff8194485c4a4.title: The heart of the fire stronghold
paragraphs: The main citadel chambers lay behind the salamanders’ attack. The company’s pursuit reached the leaders directing that assault.

30aa5bbcda0cc0d506ea246c.title: Circles beneath the canopy
paragraphs: Green circles enclose the settlement beneath the canopy. The site accompanies the elven connections carried forward from Ossington.

4d556f96ff8a06bea3f1df44.title: Another elven circle
paragraphs: Smaller green enclosures mark another elven site. These communities had histories the company was still uncovering below the surface.

8b45e5cf13ee30b79d1c709f.title: The temple dungeon
paragraphs: The temple’s chambers lie in darkness beneath the earth. The company’s pursuit of Dyson and his companions continued into the underground expedition.

d74b25c457b1f04e7c628e1e.title: The narrower way below
paragraphs: Stone narrows around the passage. Beyond such corridors, the company found inhabited enclaves and forces already at war.

e8a0ac87a79eb115fc844be2.title: The enclave's approach
paragraphs: A narrow route crosses fire at the enclave’s entrance. The company arrived while the salamanders’ assault was already under way.

51b3bc1686996ae4a0e1e18f.title: An underground village
paragraphs: Homes cluster among the underground growth. They show the settlements threatened by the war in Deep Horizon.

39ea71705249947c3c8572e5.title: Walls on the road to a greater fortress
paragraphs: Walls enclose the defended courtyard. The illustration accompanies the company’s route from Rigus towards Imperagon’s fortress.

0ecc7d41f22e476bed29abe1.title: The next enclosure
paragraphs: Further walls and gates divide the approach. The company crossed defended ground on its way to the imprisoned smiths.

22590c51b64df2962bb2855f.title: Within the stone defences
paragraphs: Routes and rooms run within the stone defences. They illustrate the strongholds encountered on the planar expedition towards Imperagon.

209260823637357f02c48d91.title: Kolyoral in the void
paragraphs: The immense cube hung in Acheron, a battlefield made into a world of its own. The company's journey beyond Rigus carried it into a plane where even the ground could move like a weapon.

ae9a7036d4f5fd6716b1b9da.title: Across the cube's faces
paragraphs: The map spreads out Kolyoral’s faces. Its cube-shaped terrain surrounded the company’s approach to the Iron Fortress.

90851340bc5a28b136577ccd.title: Zandikar, ground level
paragraphs: Zandikar became Terry’s stronghold after Imperagon fell. The Armor of Zandikar tied its gates and golem guardians to the planar forge.

384ad499b9ac76d82ab29487.title: Zandikar, upper level
paragraphs: The upper plan extends through Zandikar’s rooms. Terry gained these chambers with the fortress after defeating its former master.

ddaf8ef51207938df3caced6.title: Packleader Tavarus
paragraphs: Packleader Tavarus opposed the company during the fortress expedition. His portrait identifies one of the leaders among its defenders.

01e75d5444047b85731b35f3.title: Pitboss
paragraphs: Pitboss appears among the contacts around Rigus and Acheron. His portrait sits with the company’s preparations for the planar crossing.

6ab322b6bd80066ebc4b5278.title: The lion gate
paragraphs: The glowing circular gateway marked a passage beyond Rigus and the familiar world. Crossing it brought the company onto the road to Acheron and Imperagon's fortress.

6041f61c931033a9025e1c90.title: The behir's coils
paragraphs: The behir coils through its campaign portrait. Its large body illustrates the creatures threatening the fortress’s approaches.

f17c4a6f9a8b506bc4cff390.title: Thomas among the faces of the road
paragraphs: Thomas appears among the faces of the fortress journey. His portrait accompanies the meetings surrounding the company’s crossing towards Acheron.

ef4d522a7c3bf30af0eeba73.title: The Stagger Inn
paragraphs: Lamps and tables furnish the Stagger Inn. In Rigus, such rooms gave the company a place to rest and gather information before crossing the gate.

41ab16827334089424c6d24b.title: Varachus
paragraphs: The company met Varachus on its road towards Acheron. His infernal appearance accompanied dealings that led towards Imperagon’s fortress.

af48327e602ab4dbd398aa3c.title: Varachus's mission
paragraphs: Varachus delivers his mission in the film. His address concerns the scattered weapon and the smiths’ imprisoned souls.

b9a9c380acaa4e7e99c737a6.title: The bloodstained guild notebook
paragraphs: Blood stains the notes Thunder obtained after arranging a meeting with the last members of Brindinford’s thieves’ guild in Rigus. They had already suffered losses there; the meeting ended in a slaughter. Beneath the stains, the Guildmaster’s account follows the Baron’s guards, stolen adamantum, drow in the city, and Varachus’s obligation in Acheron. The pages do not name the killers at the meeting.

24c4a0cd9f955ed86a52a26b.title: A vessel for stranger seas
paragraphs: The unusual vessel depicts travel across stranger waters. Angajuk’s passage would carry the company through the Astral Sea towards Acheron.

17713a6c3ffd55da811e8000.title: A formian warrior
paragraphs: The formian warrior served among Acheron’s living guards. Its ranks defended the approaches the company had to cross.

094c6a0901a563c02656f88f.title: The formian queen
paragraphs: The formian queen ruled above the warrior ranks. Her portrait shows the hierarchy behind the defenders.

ca7443fa2a3c2c22bebfd40f.title: The formian myrmarch
paragraphs: The formian myrmarch directed the ranks below it. The defenders could coordinate their response to intruders.

b1627245d64cfcd10c7b01c5.title: An archon's trumpet
paragraphs: The trumpet archon appears among the planar figures around the Rigus journey. Its celestial nature contrasts with the fiends also encountered beyond the gate.

ed27e0216253f4d607ceada3.title: Too many heads
paragraphs: The hydra illustrates the living threats around the fortress’s approaches. Its many heads could strike at once.

255b48b8180b3ee3e4f04314.title: Comfort on an enormous scale
paragraphs: An enormous, richly dressed figure presides in this courtly image. It evokes the audiences and displays of wealth surrounding the company’s planar travels.

b775ac65d741c519e4791ffc.title: A fiend in the wider war
paragraphs: The horned fiend illustrates the infernal interests in the great weapons and imprisoned spirits. Imperagon’s conquest drew support from beyond the mortal world.

aa690e839fed796445368b23.title: Brindinford on another map
paragraphs: Brindinford appears on a map within the fortress chapter. Other maps placed hostile forces near the town while Team Biscuit crossed the planes.

ae99cb0884cc9d9fa247ce5a.title: Rigus at the edge of Acheron
paragraphs: Rigus opened the way into Acheron. After its fall, refugees fled to the Red Keep and fought to hold it.

84e99e6738e0313eae1f8595.title: The older art of dungeon danger
paragraphs: Traps and waiting creatures fill these old dungeon illustrations. They recall the rooms the company crossed during its fortress expedition.

e881fea561117e0362ab7c8c.title: A watcher at the threshold
paragraphs: The dark watcher stands among stone and treasure. Its image accompanies the powers pursuing Thunder for his descent from Dydd.

fc81e20af5d1fc474d7995e8.title: An elder's familiar face
paragraphs: The elder gnome recalls Eudostis in Grim’s family history. The Sleeper later explained his theft of the Time Stone and decades of captivity as a parrot.

ab10bdd3a0fb849d7cad7840.title: An anchor for the journey
paragraphs: The anchor appears with Captain Pepper and the Deliverance. Thunder’s Pendant of the Ethereal Anchor bound his soul to that ghostly ship.

d62bbd751ebaab8287fd65ad.title: The Deliverance beneath the waves
paragraphs: Captain Pepper and Xanthar directed passage aboard the spectral Deliverance. The ship later caught Team Gravy’s falling boat above Brindinford Falls.

989e61047322f4997a0932bf.title: Brother Xanthar's familiar face
paragraphs: Brother Xanthar’s face conceals the aboleth encountered beneath the water. Hindsight: he made this body using Grim’s lost and forgotten flesh-golem book. His power and constructed form spared him the zombie fate after a K-vial infection left him convinced he was Keraptis; he defeated the reigning K-clone prime and seized White Plume Mountain.

Revisionist: Echoes in the Abyss reveals his separate plan to become a trusted older brother in Grim’s memories. The manufactured body is confirmed; Grim’s final choice in the solo remains unknown. His profile links to the full account.

56a90f5b423ae628007fc8eb.title: Keraptis leaves his mark
paragraphs: The eight-armed emblem signed Keraptis’s invitation to White Plume Mountain. Hindsight: a K-vial later left Xanthar convinced he was that wizard. After defeating the reigning K-clone prime, he took the mountain; his belief does not establish that he is the original Keraptis.

4312af925c6cec0142cde947.title: Wave
paragraphs: Wave was the trident named in Keraptis’s challenge and later gathered for the Candle of the Dark One. Hindsight: Xanthar returned it with Whelm and Frostrazor to White Plume Mountain. They will never forgive the Brotherhood for sacrificing their sibling, Blackrazor.

960f3cc750e2a28eff2f6ec3.title: Easthaven in the long winter
paragraphs: Snow and frozen water surround Easthaven’s lit windows. The company helped secure food for a town struggling through the long winter.

2f0b37683fe5db80602205d8.title: The execution square
paragraphs: Easthaven’s public square was used for punishment as well as town gatherings. The northern journey brought the company through its frightened communities and dangerous magic.

c0f81947bc84bb9cf3238e13.title: The White Lady Inn
paragraphs: The White Lady Inn stood amid Easthaven’s snow and ghost stories. The company eventually laid the White Lady’s haunting to rest.

900fa846ba001c10683d2d10.title: A northern tavern's welcome
paragraphs: Travellers gather among the Northlook’s timber and lamps. Here Olaf brought Pelor’s guidance to Terry.

f5b9667224f79addd6c2e7c5.title: Dzaan at the stake
paragraphs: Dzaan burns at the stake in this image of the Arcane Brotherhood’s northern troubles. The company’s later search reached the Lost Spire and Vellynne’s undead servants.

11148c07fa6aaf5db6a638ed.title: The little shape of Pengu
paragraphs: Shrop released Pengu’s spirit by snuffing the Nightmare Grotto candle. This small, green-eyed form concealed the power that drained magic from the world. Terry’s fourfold attunement and Blackrazor’s sacrifice completed the ritual before the company escaped Frostblight.

3d123f9ed11e32061659746b.title: Pengu becomes something worse
paragraphs: Pengu’s transformed body reveals the power behind the anti-magic waves. Terry’s attunement and Blackrazor’s sacrifice completed the ritual; after Frostblight fell, magic began its gradual recovery.

8840d1592c665ab405bde5c9.title: Pengu among the followers
paragraphs: The enormous penguin monument stood over Frostblight. It shattered during the company’s escape, after the completed ritual and Pengu’s collapse into a pulsing obsidian egg.

33ea4e67202d93232369bb38.title: The Dreamkeepers
paragraphs: Pengu mutated its followers into Dreamkeepers. They served the spirit’s spreading power in the north.

a97a34fae271ff6c94762fa5.title: The herd moves on
paragraphs: Penguins depart across scarred northern ground. Pengu’s surviving egg still pulsed after the battle, leaving its eventual fate unresolved.

e303b74915996ae69b23a8c0.title: Pengu speaks from the ice
paragraphs: Pengu speaks from an ice throne. The spirit used Auril’s power to extend its rule across the north.

ef7b08301b1d7a766c75c9b2.title: An offer from Pengu
paragraphs: Pengu invites the mortals to kneel in this address. It treats their world as a source of power for its return.

4e4b34aca337efd61d22d803.title: Kaelith, the Forsaken Queen
paragraphs: Kaelith’s frozen crown survived her corruption. Once Queen Aeloria Frostsong of the Panguini, she became an enforcer for Pengu after resisting the invasion.

2cc3c3e5879f333a0d5169bb.title: The fungal dark
paragraphs: The luminous growth leads into the grotto explored by Brunn, Rook, Nox, and Elira. Beneath that strange beauty lay a planar wound whose escape route would eventually join Team Gravy to Team Biscuit in sunken Brindinford.

5fcbd73c6cb3377179e0cfb4.title: The Stony Gaze returns
paragraphs: The Stony Gaze appears again during the Sleeper detour. The company visited the familiar inn while living as its earlier selves in Brindinford.

de3ec6ccb9e8d06646b28e94.title: A monster's beginning
paragraphs: The image shows a tiny dragon at the start of its life. It sits with the Bastion chapter, where ancient Ashardalon feeds on souls before their first birth.

905aae4f286595b0526dd6a9.title: The roads the party was following
paragraphs: The diagram gathers people and places from the interrupted Bastion investigation. Thunder’s ancestry, the soul famine and rival demonic plans led the company along its different branches.

02ebf010ea0979c136f35f35.title: A vision with an enormous audience
paragraphs: An enormous presence towers over the company in this dream image. The Sleeper’s answers connected their immediate questions with the powers behind the soul crisis.

6d71257bc2e4d930bf393ecc.title: The Den of Ruin
paragraphs: The Den of Ruin appears as an isolated refuge. Its plan accompanies the hidden approaches and watchers of the Bastion investigation.

81cfc903a5a4c3dd179150c5.title: A circle around an ancient tree
paragraphs: Buildings surround the great tree at the Church of the Elements. The First Tree investigation brought the company news of Dydd before its long detours from Bastion.

b7c32d4ff0e730902b3b2756.title: A vessel beyond ordinary roads
paragraphs: The vessel is shown from above. It illustrates the unfamiliar transport used on the campaign’s journeys towards Acheron.

9056c44dab81cc8dd7436e69.title: The passage grows darker
paragraphs: Broken stone narrows the approach to the defended ruin. The image accompanies the passages the company crossed on its fortress expedition.

1415547ad637ec143911eb51.title: Answers among the roots
paragraphs: Figures gather beneath great roots in the old illustration. The First Tree’s druidical knowledge helped the company investigate the soul crisis.

1f5930d3dbbb2e9b789780c1.title: Questions of life and death
paragraphs: Branching passages divide this plan. It accompanies the investigation that eventually led the company to the birthplace of souls.

e64872b471c45594fd3d4b6b.title: Ashardalon at the centre of the web
paragraphs: Ashardalon stands at the centre of the investigation diagram. Dydd’s bloodline, the rival demonic minds and the unborn souls all led towards the Bastion.

6b5d51233e51108435bcbab5.title: A courtyard in the town's defence
paragraphs: Guarded buildings enclose the town courtyard. The image recalls Brindinford’s civic defences while the company travelled elsewhere.

0f2c3c633d1066d39d91f80d.title: The roads behind the walls
paragraphs: Walls and gates surround the town streets. Brindinford still faced hostile forces while the adventurers were away across the planes.

a308cf44333e421a57ee6d13.title: Ships at the water's edge
paragraphs: Ships lie beside the harbour. The campaign’s later voyages aboard the Deliverance would carry a boat through a waterfall rescue and back beneath the earth.

f8ec237b53624eb6546a7826.title: Fire through the mountain
paragraphs: Molten routes run past massive wheels in the fortress landscape. Its forge used imprisoned smiths’ spirits to reforge the weapon Imperagon sought.

d63e15ee7a99bf2ca578ee8d.title: Brindinford under threat
paragraphs: Defenders gather around a burning settlement in this illustration. It accompanies the threats to the company’s home while its travels carried it across the planes.

cbee2138a5f9e7e3cbea4dd5.title: A serpent among the hidden powers
paragraphs: The serpentine figure illustrates an inhuman power behind the investigation. The Cathezar pursued Thunder because his ancestry could be used against Ashardalon.

2b936ebb147e0a23ede032ee.title: A small token with a darker promise
paragraphs: The red pendant hangs among the campaign’s small magical tokens. Its bloodlike colour accompanies the hunt for Dydd’s living descendant.

117b3f59951c5e3e0d1982ba.title: Nurn's borrowed face
paragraphs: Nurn wore a human guise while serving Hethradiah, the rival mind within Demogorgon. The slaad pursued the same descendant of Dydd sought by the Cathezar.

534b1a3debbfd011bd79aa03.title: A prisoner and the cost of the war
paragraphs: The captive is chained in a cell. The image accompanies the prisoners and suffering around the Red Keep’s war.

13b26e39d350650727fa1e72.title: Shoomma's smithy
paragraphs: Shoomma and Horken’s workrooms held the smithy’s tools and equipment. The company invested there during its return to earlier Brindinford.

23f85b20823797efebbdb41a.title: The First Tree's older knowledge
paragraphs: The ancient tree illustrates the druidical history of Ashardalon and Dydd. The company sought those answers before dreams and Icewind Dale interrupted its Bastion investigation.

109395cc0590b0a1fd928f96.title: Myra the Dragonhearted
paragraphs: Myra was a cleric of Tiamat and companion to the dragon Paraselson. Her portrait accompanies the occupied Bastion; the company’s final encounter remains unresolved.

94f36f9823d642c7161cbab2.title: Baldur's Gate on the wider map
paragraphs: Baldur’s Gate appears on the coast map. The Sleeper investigation ranged across familiar places while displacing the company in time.

c4e1dad40836a9fdd7a04a8a.title: A face for the Sleeper's mystery
paragraphs: The portrait sits with the Sleeper and Guild of Sleep investigation. That inquiry exposed Eudostis’s captivity, the stolen Time Stone and the route into the company’s past.

f9f46dff5ad41aeb0eafe3d9.title: A warrior in the dream's company
paragraphs: The armoured warrior illustrates the dangers around the Sleeper’s history. Eudostis’s part in that history ended in decades of captivity as a parrot.

debdf292dda3fcdae533ec09.title: Beneath the Guild of Sleep
paragraphs: These chambers lay below the Guild of Sleep. The investigation led from them towards the Sleeper, the Time Stone and the company’s own past.

8e474840988f512b427b00e5.title: A familiar face from the dream's circle
paragraphs: The red-clad figure appears among the dream-road portraits. The company was uncovering the long history of the Sleeper and the stolen Time Stone.

e1c1d7b491dc0599e96e7cd9.title: A table worth coming back to
paragraphs: Food crowds the table in this image of Brindinford’s hospitality. During the flashback, the company could return to the meals and rooms of its earlier life.

ddefec5277fc387e37ffe8fe.title: A boat for an uncertain passage
paragraphs: This is the little craft carried out of the grotto and over Brindinford Falls. The Deliverance caught it before dropping it back into the underground river.

db6594860f313406813e9577.title: The other grotto
paragraphs: Crimson Crazuk’s Nightmare Grotto held souls in candles. Shrop extinguished the candle that released Pengu, causing the loss of magic later faced in Icewind Dale.

cb39bf6c8e6c36673d27aaf7.title: Crimson Crazuk's darkness
paragraphs: The bleeding skull illustrates Crimson Crazuk’s Nightmare Grotto. The lich was destroyed, but Shrop’s extinguished candle had released Pengu and the loss of magic followed.

28f8265d4ce8bf36b1040dcb.title: A demand from the dragon
paragraphs: The red dragon addresses mortals with a demand. The film sits among the company’s encounters with powerful beings before its return towards Bastion.

fca618798784bfbb7b6387b1.title: The Sleeper's first greeting
paragraphs: The Sleeper appears in this filmed greeting. The conversation that followed explained the stolen Time Stone and drew the company into its dream detour.

c6dbbdd88f9b78243f07a02d.title: Demogorgon's divided purpose
paragraphs: The two-headed demon prince gives a body to the conflict between Aameul and Hethradiah. Their competing designs made the company’s struggle against Ashardalon useful to enemies with no interest in saving the unborn.

c10b8f3ca801c77d42e28a35.title: Eudostis remembers
paragraphs: Remembered images surround Eudostis in the film. His attempt to free the Sleeper had released Crimson Crazuk and led to his own long captivity.

5193d3d3f751af4a8282b1d0.title: The Dreamer names Aameul
paragraphs: The Dreamer's explanation brings the company closer to one mind of Demogorgon and the design behind the Cathezar's hunt. Ashardalon's failing heart was also the prize in another monster's attempt to survive alone.

c11c652b45ec645483d65961.title: The Dreamer speaks of Ashardalon
paragraphs: The Dreamer describes Ashardalon’s survival after Dydd wounded his heart. The dragon’s need to sustain that life had caused the soul famine.

d29284a09681c4e52c91a182.title: The Dreamer points to the Bastion
paragraphs: The Dreamer describes the Bastion, where souls gather before birth. Reaching it required a Soul Totem fragment and passage through the dangerous Positive Energy Plane.

1d1ceaba935fd54b924bf594.title: The Dreamer and the fallen god
paragraphs: Desayeus still possessed a Soul Totem fragment in his prison. The Dreamer’s account led the company towards him as a way into the Bastion.

49d391265bfec0f5b163b749.title: The Dreamer names Eco
paragraphs: Eco’s body was the doorway to Desayeus’s prison. The company needed to pass her to seek his Soul Totem fragment.

2c86a2bcf466d530ded6deb1.title: The Dreamer explains the key
paragraphs: The Dreamer’s account turns to the broken pieces of Desayeus’s Soul Totem and the means of entering the Bastion. The company would eventually have to ask the fallen god for the fragment he still wore.

2925c60b471e38de1b5cd9fb.title: The ancestor in the Dreamer's tale
paragraphs: Eudostis stole the Time Stone while trying to free the Sleeper, releasing Crimson Crazuk. Lydzin later imprisoned Grim’s ancestor in a parrot’s body.

3a46ea47eb4968e5e64e530e.title: The Dreamer begins the tale
paragraphs: The Dreamer begins the conversation reached through sleep. Her answers explain decisions and people from before the company’s current journey.

7565bbfcfb95b724a4159698.title: The Church of Terry
paragraphs: The Church of Terry had rooms and a life beyond its priest’s travels. The company asked Ernie about its fate when he returned.

2d3c68824292a1b91cfd1f74.title: Time catches the Dreamer
paragraphs: Age begins catching up with the Dreamer when she wakes. She asks the company to repair her pod, while its own displaced years remain unresolved.

d51ed1a65d8ef5a821e9c09e.title: Dream a Little Dream
paragraphs: The radiant gathering marks the turn towards the company’s earlier lives. In Brindinford, they became their eighth-level selves again.

c961a67cf6488711eddb57d6.title: Shrop inside the dream
paragraphs: Shrop stands before the Dreamer during the time detour. He and his companions would eventually return twenty years beyond their original present.

a10fc9a217815a9a75220b98.title: The carnival barker
paragraphs: The carnival barker delivers another theatrical invitation. His salesmanship supplies some of the dream-road’s humour.

13a97c9f5a4025e947429080.title: Zemana
paragraphs: Zemana was an independent elven arcanist with a perfectionist’s interest in enchantment. Her portrait appears among the practitioners of magic in the dream-bound chapter.

085db9b34b7e8637007e298b.title: The Time Stone's clockwork echo
paragraphs: The intricate dial represents the Time Stone’s power. Eudostis stole the Stone to free the Sleeper and inadvertently released Crimson Crazuk.

fd2d8f2975a750d211f70411.title: A bed for travelling out of time
paragraphs: The little bed illustrates the campaign’s passages through sleep. The Sleeper’s detour would return the company to its earlier lives in Brindinford.

a082c398ed94f2cc921f44e3.title: Water flowing through the air
paragraphs: Water flows through the air in White Plume Mountain. Keraptis’s challenge made crossing its rooms dangerous before the company even reached their guardians.

0c90e3b744f49d27d90247c4.title: The crab beyond the bubble
paragraphs: The armoured crab guarded the route to Wave beyond the boiling bubble. It was one of the obstacles named in Keraptis’s challenge.

9853054ddd4a7b533a148120.title: The living town beyond the dream
paragraphs: The townscape shows Brindinford before its later ruin. The company walked these earlier streets during the Sleeper’s time detour.

f4bc05b2ea78c215dba00617.title: The Narrator's grin
paragraphs: The die-marked skull is the Narrator’s campaign emblem. It smiles over a story whose Ashardalon confrontation is still unfinished.

9cbc94ecf76ec9e4a142802e.title: Every question led towards the Bastion
paragraphs: The collected goals connect the interrupted Bastion investigation. Thunder’s ancestry and the missing souls both pointed towards Ashardalon.

19efa29372286cde93e35d24.title: The Dreamer's displeasure
paragraphs: The Dreamer appears against the ice. The image follows the dream-bound investigation into the northern journey.

fc5399725f2ef771d336192a.title: A face worn by the long road
paragraphs: The weathered figure appears among the portraits of the time detour. Beyond the dream, the company would return to a world that had aged twenty years without it.

92db6b1630e54173df2f1e5a.title: Captain Timothy Pepper
paragraphs: Pepper commanded the Deliverance when its strange voyage crossed the paths of the two companies. His ship's arrival beside the falling boat exchanged Brindinford Falls for a desperate return to the underground river.

91152e48419431995926abe0.title: The dire weasel
paragraphs: The dire weasel enlarges the familiar scout’s shape. Scouting ahead was part of Grim’s work in the dangerous passages the company explored.

30b86f51278b96993fba03f9.title: A passage through the stars
paragraphs: A distant light marks the crossing in this travel image. The Soul Totem fragment later guided the company through the deadly radiance towards the Bastion.

504fb883f1a83b4c6c58b056.title: A rod for a quiet hour
paragraphs: The elaborate fishing rod was intended for a quiet hour. Brindinford’s earlier streets gave the company time for purchases as well as investments and preparations.

335fec1d1fd8bbba8c82a782.title: A hunger from stranger depths
paragraphs: The pale, open-mouthed creature illustrates the underwater expedition’s horrors. An aboleth’s influence could reach into a victim’s mind and change its body.

9b5b7d88e158499cb78621e5.title: Neverwinter on the road north
paragraphs: The map places Neverwinter on the coastal hunt for Keraptis. Rumours about the stolen weapons pointed north towards the ice.

f471e2eb538751c5f104bafd.title: Tentacles beyond the water
paragraphs: Tentacles coil through this aquatic creature’s image. The aboleth encountered below the surface could enslave victims and communicate with them at a distance.

5188d7a7c3631240e46e9877.title: A camp before the next crossing
paragraphs: The camp offered shelter between journeys. On the northern road, cold and Terry’s altered behaviour accompanied the company’s preparations.

2405e32de11e063e6c375617.title: The Bank of Frobozz
paragraphs: The company invested with the Bank of Frobozz during its return to earlier Brindinford. Its money remained part of the time-displaced journey, with the eventual return unresolved.

92c6408d4077fda950990c49.title: Luskan by its bridges
paragraphs: Luskan’s river and bridges appear on the coastal weapons trail. The Arcane Brotherhood’s interests reached towards the northern spire and its corrupted inhabitants.

a887bd5e1e803472ec1d4ff9.title: The City of Pirates
paragraphs: Luskan’s harbour and towers open onto the coastal routes. Rumours about the legendary weapons travelled through a city of sailors, wizards and thieves.

172be4b9372b8bfbc39418fb.title: A place for Grim to call home
paragraphs: Grim’s home offered room for books and possessions beyond the expedition. Its image sits with the return to earlier Brindinford and the company’s plans for a settled future.

c2e9b7512666f71c29158d3e.title: Ashardalon
paragraphs: The ancient red dragon had survived Dydd's destruction of his heart by binding Ammet within himself. At the Bastion, his dependence on unborn souls turned that refusal to die into a disaster reaching across the world.

56c1be328128c97083ac9ff6.title: Po of the Bastion
paragraphs: Po met the company among the defenders inside the crystalline fortress. His fall came during the hard passage through the dragonspawn and Grisly's ambush on the way towards Ashardalon.

f207733f09579b3a35d1b311.title: The dragon's terrible presence
paragraphs: Ashardalon fills this vision of the ancient red dragon. His final fate remains unwritten until the company’s confrontation is resolved.

deeca74dee22cf2e62e16f47.title: Oakhurst, where people waited
paragraphs: Oakhurst awaited news of the missing Hucreles. The company returned from the Citadel with their rings and a warning about twig blights.

09923c7d04eabbdc4d3904e4.title: The Gulthias Tree
paragraphs: The Gulthias Tree grew from the stake that had pinned a vampire. Belak used its fruit to spread the blights found beneath Oakhurst.

3225e134fa7549ea8e690341.title: A flashback upon the water
paragraphs: The film returns to a boat on the company’s earlier river journey. Brindinford’s waterways would recur in later, stranger voyages.

af177eb6b6b06f2f0ec7050b.title: A stop in the wooded dark
paragraphs: The forest battlefield lies along the investigation around Ossington. The company’s ambush there failed, forcing a race back to the village.

f6517e6924d320739d97daeb.title: Glitterhame in another light
paragraphs: Mist and fungi light this view of the Glitterhame. The company crossed its waters and growth beneath Khundrukar.

788a4009c52a23af0bf8322a.title: The warlord's wooded ground
paragraphs: The clearing illustrates the wooded country around Saithnar’s barrow. His answers brought its older wars into the Ossington investigation.

871321f46cddf4cc50c12c0b.title: The catacombs below Nightfang
paragraphs: Girallons and servitors occupied Nightfang’s catacombs. Thiff’s rebellion challenged Gulthias’s control among them.

f63d95454ef08d07878ffb9b.title: The bargain, another telling
paragraphs: The longer film returns to the forest meeting with the elemental guardian. It preserves another telling of the bargain on the road to Nightfang.

e036b5ac103d62dfc9377650.title: Gulthias
paragraphs: Gulthias’s legacy had already reached the Sunless Citadel. In Nightfang, his undead cult used Ashardalon’s severed heart while hoping for the dragon’s return.

3598b3eb94c69b32ef5e8812.title: Fire on the old road
paragraphs: The burning figure illustrates the Ossington chapter. The company escaped an ambush and returned to a tower that exploded in flames.

ded63af023f2e169941fcab0.title: An unwelcome reputation
paragraphs: Shrop’s wanted notice gives the company’s reputation a comic face. In Brindinford, public gratitude had coexisted with orders against the people who helped the town.

7908baaf4c6e2cf4ba9f99ff.title: Brindinford's docks
paragraphs: Brindinford’s docks joined the early river routes. Those approaches later led towards ruins, the Deliverance and the passage beneath the earth.

37214aa11f3b1055401cab70.title: Almut Shield-Breaker
paragraphs: Almut Shield-Breaker appears among the dwarven portraits of the forge chapter. The company’s search for Durgeddin’s work took place among such traditions of craft and warfare.

b327f5b9aed79c5a2a04ec08.title: The wider Faerûn
paragraphs: The map shows the wider reaches of Faerûn. Later journeys carried the company beyond them into Acheron and the Bastion’s plane.

2f45279208fff79f367c6f54.title: Downriver between adventures
paragraphs: The river route joins Brindinford and Blasingdell. It connects the company’s early travels between the dungeons and towns.

ba2fe62daac1f1410b5a0001.title: Thunder before another disguise
paragraphs: Thunder carried his lycanthropy alongside his skill as a scout. He disclosed the curse to his companions after their earliest expedition.

ec5e626aa61654f84d1c8d33.title: Grim, ready with an answer
paragraphs: Shrop found Grim in the Citadel. The wizard brought familiar scouting, dragon lore and the proposal to subdue the missing adventurers.

ec1f56c343ece78d692d7368.title: A captain's imposing figure
paragraphs: The bearded captain stands in imposing dress. His portrait sits with the voyages and crews surrounding the Deliverance chapter.

268911643d62d2a7f94e99ab.title: Under canvas for the night
paragraphs: The tent is furnished for a night on the road. It sits with the company’s preparations during the return to earlier Brindinford.

ec700f7cca86cb654782da8b.title: Thomo
paragraphs: Thomo appears among Brindinford’s local portraits. The town’s residents were caught between the fair and the conspiracy that seized it.

595287b844ea1764d8b93027.title: The Bear Pit poster
paragraphs: The Bear Pit poster advertises entertainment under the Stolen Sons’ name. The organisation’s interests reached into the fair the company visited.

ef58d8ad7a9cc62e11634415.title: Paths through a green cavern
paragraphs: Pools and branching paths fill the green cavern. Settlements lay along such routes through the inhabited depths of Deep Horizon.

729b1eaf97713bff190b0f1e.title: A shadow from the deeper hunt
paragraphs: The winged, tentacled creature illustrates the deep expedition’s horrors. Its silhouette sits among the enemies gathered around the underground war.

9f0a771b2f3804c9bd4087af.title: Cloak and Dagger
paragraphs: Two familiar figures take up the Cloak and Dagger disguises. The joke belongs to the campaign’s investigations and concealed identities.

07b6c5e3c9ceef1c330daf91.title: Grimble's rooms
paragraphs: Grimble’s furnished rooms hold books, belongings and a table. They show the home the scholar could return to between expeditions.

Revisionist: Echoes in the Abyss borrowed Grim’s childhood home to make Xanthar seem like family. This artwork illustrates that borrowed setting; no map of the dream has been recovered. Grim’s profile links to the complete ordeal.

c7e52735ffcc06481d5f2910.title: The smugglers' cove
paragraphs: Boats hide beneath the stone at the smugglers’ cove. The covert trade linked the deep expedition to captives taken from Brindinford and other surface towns.

5bdfeb48b7550a7939617043.title: The fishing vendor
paragraphs: The fishing vendor served the company’s quieter purchases. In earlier Brindinford, the party could shop for leisure as well as arrange investments.

561357bf0a3c466e8a465d26.title: The Cuckoo's face
paragraphs: The Cuckoo's name returns in the demon guard encountered as the company forced its way deeper into the Bastion. This unassuming portrait gives that ominous title a surprisingly ordinary face.

f03c7b0ea064c1f34e0f642b.title: Under the town's streets
paragraphs: Sewer bends run below the town’s streets. The company investigated concealed routes beneath Brindinford’s fair and public proclamations.

95bc65c351ca848dd6460954.title: The Outlands and the gates beyond
paragraphs: The ring of gate-towns places Rigus on the Outlands map. Its gate opened into Acheron.

98f2647719524525fff2364c.title: The old pond from above
paragraphs: The small pond preserves an ordinary corner of the campaign landscape. It sits among the towns and resting places between expeditions.

12d0fa739b58d859556e5b07.title: Brindinford's barracks
paragraphs: The barracks became hard-won ground when the two companies fought through the ant-held Sunken City. A building once tied to the town guard now offered a position from which exhausted survivors could consider the next advance.

c70af5773352df7a5fbd1dd2.title: The bell tower in the town's memory
paragraphs: The plan shows Brindinford’s familiar bell tower. In the later buried city, the colony’s hidden system of resonance and control centred on that landmark.

6fc1acd0a39beb0f77654920.title: The detective and the kraken
paragraphs: A kraken towers over the purple-coated detective. The theatrical scene turns Brindinford’s hidden horrors into a campaign joke.

51c3360536b2ed1e5dc855a3.title: At Eastgate's end
paragraphs: Figures gather at Brindinford’s Eastgate. The Baron’s proclamation later closed the gates, banned weapons and outlawed Pelor’s priests.

d7445c211f0b05bac41536d8.title: Acheron's impossible ground
paragraphs: Great cubes drifted through a plane shaped by endless war, making the ground itself a moving threat. Team Biscuit's route from Rigus to the Iron Fortress carried it into this vast and hostile landscape.

4847851838a9af12e308c28d.title: Shoomma
paragraphs: Shoomma ran the smithy with Horken. The company invested with them during the return to earlier Brindinford.

094db84d721bd6ee6015cad9.title: Durgeddin the Black
paragraphs: Durgeddin’s lost works drew the company towards Khundrukar. Terry sought his forge and dwarven history beneath the Stone Tooth.

259eab3470d80228b0881f23.title: Terry, ready to stand in front
paragraphs: Terry brought healing, strength and chalk into Khundrukar. The company depended on him to tend its wounds and mark the way.

8cf1d2aa5498f8d6b29c6ac7.title: The battle for Brindinford
paragraphs: The marked map places forces around Brindinford. Hostile armies threatened the town while the company travelled across the planes.

9032b1bf7f56735f3e185656.title: Meepo of the Citadel
paragraphs: Meepo lived among the Citadel’s kobolds. His troubles involved Calcryx and the rival factions inside the buried fortress.

72a78c71a9443f37358f2ce0.title: Show me a king
paragraphs: The red dragon questions travellers who vanished from its reach. Its address demands an account of their disappearance and the wizards’ part in it.

eb9baf91ccb433a10edad20b.title: A priest of Pelor
paragraphs: Pelor’s priest appears among the people threatened in Brindinford. Shrop sacrificed Shatterspike to help cleanse their temple.

4b3b5f1e123c818df00f01e9.title: The quiet white cloak
paragraphs: Ernie’s smile and gestures were familiar when he returned after the explosion. Hindsight: he recovered most of the gear, but Xanthar had taken Wave, Whelm and Frostrazor back to White Plume Mountain. Blackrazor had already been sacrificed, and its three siblings still hate the Brotherhood for that choice.

7f0785a735acb7da0bcccf5c.title: Shrop's new dream, first passage
paragraphs: Shrop and his companions gather at the dream’s opening. The passage would take them back into their earlier lives.

1f5f1edbfbe56925b6ac7672.title: Shrop's new dream, the crossing
paragraphs: Radiance carries the dream from conversation into a crossing. The company’s eventual return from earlier Brindinford would overshoot its original time by twenty years.

40f1dbcd158ebe6cc33745b9.title: Gramps to the rescue
paragraphs: The elder appears among the dream figures. Eudostis’s theft of the Time Stone connected Grim’s family to the Sleeper investigation.

9f3877ab6480f2ac2aacf29e.title: Gathered in the chamber
paragraphs: Figures assemble around a long table. The audience sits with the northern questions about Terry’s changed voice and divine obligations.

e4cdb9ae5e9fe6297199e8fb.title: The chamber's answer
paragraphs: The chamber gathering continues around Terry and his companions. Their conversation concerns the divine questions of the northern journey.

cdcc6c696090285ff8be2af5.title: The next word in the chamber
paragraphs: The film continues the audience in the chamber. Its figures surround Terry during the part of the northern story marked by his altered behaviour.

cbf240c67b9e3173b52e2a0d.title: The familiar's small face
paragraphs: The little weasel recalls Grim’s familiar scouting. Such scouts could slip into passages ahead of the party.

828542a64ccfdbefbe44299c.title: Ernie's familiar gesture
paragraphs: Ernie greets the company with his familiar gestures after its feared loss of him. He returned most of the equipment. Hindsight: Xanthar had already moved the three surviving epic weapons to White Plume Mountain, where they remain hostile to the Brotherhood.

2a81cd78d1d68ef7cbfed6b4.title: Radiance in the sanctuary
paragraphs: Holy signs and light fill the sanctuary near the familiar white cloak. The scene sits with the divine messages and unanswered questions surrounding Ernie.

845114928bcefca70bcdce15.title: Words beside the fountain
paragraphs: Figures gather beside the fountain. The scene sits within the conversations of the dream-bound investigation.

9a8fe8b467539b524c1ecc91.title: Thunder's training day
paragraphs: Thunder practises his quick hands and footwork in the training film. It sits with the return to the companions’ earlier lives.

038b5acc03e9499080155f61.title: The northern trouble begins
paragraphs: The film opens on the frozen town and the forces around it. The northern chapter would bring Pengu’s army to raid Easthaven.

2ec6e96ddd5eafb1d5bc635f.title: The northern road remembered
paragraphs: The refresher returns to the icy ground of the company’s northern battles. Easthaven’s danger continued beyond the winter into Pengu’s attack.

3f7e1af6a0a41af2fe48f95f.title: Double my number
paragraphs: Terry stares vacantly and repeats his numerical riddle. His altered behaviour replaced the independence and sarcasm his companions knew.

ab0409c0d03e052826b3cdc7.title: Across the broken ice
paragraphs: The film returns to broken northern ice. Its strange interruption sits among the uncanny events surrounding Pengu’s transformations.

52c3702ae60f0227d5fc7030.title: Pelor's holy blade
paragraphs: Pelor’s radiant blade appears with the divine vision on the ice. The gods spoke there after the company’s long hunt for the legendary weapons.

328df1db1f56173759de412b.title: Pengu's grand promise
paragraphs: Pengu gives another icy address promising power. The company later defeated its fighting form, leaving the pulsing egg’s future unresolved.

16d24d9bcf63aa36a4269793.title: Divine dreams
paragraphs: The dream brings gods and the great weapons into the northern journey. Their message would send the company back towards Rigus and the unfinished Bastion investigation.

d0a2c035724ddb3437495576.title: A dance at the portal
paragraphs: A figure dances at the magical portal. The film gives the campaign’s planar travel an undignified pause.

2b54238995719e78071af082.title: Pelor's temple, room by room
paragraphs: Pelor’s temple is shown room by room. The company fought to restore this sanctuary for the priests and refugees of Brindinford.

b5df35c40648b1b6ebd10829.title: Shrop's signature fishing rod
paragraphs: Shrop carried a signature fishing rod among his possessions. It recalls the quieter purchases made in earlier Brindinford.

6e14001db27c0ffd66491dc6.title: Together in the great hall
paragraphs: Shrop, Grim, Terry and Thunder stand together in the great hall. The group image brings the collection back to its four companions.

552b867b481e9a6e65697981.title: A wave from the company
paragraphs: The companions wave in the farewell film. It celebrates the people at the table while leaving their characters’ final battle unresolved.

d271ffaff4c6be084f5dbbdf.title: The warrior and the fortress
paragraphs: The spirit-haunted warrior illustrates the fortress chapter. Imprisoned smiths and a conqueror’s ambition were bound into the reforging of the Blade of Fiery Might.

9b053ed4eab8d2eddbd772c2.title: Grim's chain lightning
paragraphs: Grim’s chain lightning struck among the retriever and fiends at the Bastion’s entrance. The company fought through them to reach the sealed gate.

e75936ecc3044ec2e4573113.title: The crossing at the falls
paragraphs: A small boat passes before the waterfall, with a cave mouth glowing in the cliffside.
